test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2022 - General Knowledge (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Sam has an income of 9 lakh rupees yearly. Which tax slab (new regime) of India is applicable for him as per the new regime Income Tax Slab Rates FY 2021 - 22?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15%.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **As per the new regime Income Tax Slab Rates FY 2021 - 22, the tax slab applicable for Sam, who has an income of 9 lakh rupees yearly, is 0.15.**
 
• **Explanation**:
 
 
• The new regime Income Tax Slab Rates **FY 2021 - 22 was announced in the Union Budget 2021 by the Finance Minister.**
 
• The new regime offers lower tax rates without deductions or exemptions.
 
• The tax slab rate for an individual having an annual income of **up to Rs. 2.5 lakh is 0%.**
 
• For an individual having an annual income between **Rs. 2.5 lakh to Rs. 5 lacks, the tax slab rate is 5%.**
 
• For an individual having an annual income between **Rs. 5 lahks to Rs. 7.5 lakh, the tax slab rate is 10%**.
 
• For an individual having an annual income between** Rs. 7.5 lakh to Rs. 10 lahks, the tax slab rate is 15%.**
 
• The tax slab rates go up to 30% for individuals having an annual income above Rs. 15 lahks.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• ** **The tax slab rate of 0.2 is applicable for an individual having an annual income between Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 12.5 lakh.
 
• ** **The tax slab rate of 0.05 is applicable for an individual having an annual income between Rs. 5 lakh to Rs. 7.5 lakh under the old regime Income Tax Slab Rates FY 2021 - 22.
 
• ** **The tax slab rate of 0.1 is applicable for an individual having an annual income between Rs. 7.5 lakh to Rs. 10 lakh under the old regime Income Tax Slab Rates FY 2021 - 22.
